name: ADXTool
description: ADX (Average Directional Index) - measures trend strength (not direction). Values above 25 indicate strong trend, below 20 indicate weak/ranging market.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: ADX Period
fields.description: Period for ADX calculation. CHOOSE based on timeframe: 7-10 for short-term trend detection, 14 for standard analysis, 20-25 for longer-term trend confirmation. Higher values smooth out noise but lag more.
